f3_program: observe(at("group.goodwill.apj.carrying_amount", "2019"), 98.7, "$M", cell("APJ", "31 March 2019"))
observe(at("group.goodwill.apj.carrying_amount", "2018"), 103.6, "$M", cell("APJ", "31 March 2018"))
query("difference", at("group.goodwill.apj.carrying_amount", "2018"), at("group.goodwill.apj.carrying_amount", "2019"))
collection("store.cds", "cd", "cd store", source("At a CD store, 40% of the CDs cost $10 each, and the rest cost $5 each"))
observe(at("store.cds.count", "initial"), 200, "count", source("the total number of CDs was 200"))
percent_of(at("store.cds.price_10.count", "initial"), at("store.cds.count", "initial"), 40, source("40% of the CDs cost $10 each"))

difference_relation(at("store.cds.price_5.count", "initial"), at("store.cds.count", "initial"), at("store.cds.price_10.count", "initial"), source("40% of the CDs cost $10 each, and the rest cost $5 each"))
observe(at("store.cds.price_10.unit_price", "initial"), 10, "currency_per_cd", source("CDs cost $10 each"))
observe(at("store.cds.price_5.unit_price", "initial"), 5, "currency_per_cd", source("the rest cost $5 each"))

transfer("prince_buys_price_10_cds", "prince", at("store.cds.price_10.count", "current"), at("prince.cds.price_10.count", "current"), fraction(at("store.cds.price_10.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each"))

transfer("prince_buys_price_5_cds", "prince", at("store.cds.price_5.count", "current"), at("prince.cds.price_5.count", "current"), at("store.cds.price_5.count", "initial"), source("all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))
query("value", at("prince.money.spent_on_cds", "current"))
observe(at("mrs_lim.cow_milking.frequency", "daily"), 2, "times_per_day", source("Mrs. Lim milks her cows twice a day"))
produce("yesterday_morning_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.gallons", "current"), 68, source("Yesterday morning, she got 68 gallons of milk"))
produce("yesterday_evening_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.gallons", "current"), 82, source("in the evening, she got 82 gallons"))
offset("mrs_lim.milk.this_morning.gallons", event_field("yesterday_morning_milking", "quantity"), -18, "gallon", source("This morning, she got 18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning"))
produce("this_morning_milking", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.gallons", "current"), "mrs_lim.milk.this_morning.gallons", source("This morning, she got 18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning"))
remove("afternoon_sale", "mrs_lim", at("mrs_lim.milk.gallons", "current"), "mrs_lim.milk.afternoon_sale.gallons", source("selling some gallons of milk in the afternoon"))
observe(at("mrs_lim.milk.gallons", "after_afternoon_sale"), 24, "gallon", source("Mrs. Lim has only 24 gallons left"))
observe(at("milk.unit_price", "current"), 3.5, "currency_per_gallon", source("each gallon costs $3.50"))
query("value", at("mrs_lim.milk_sale.revenue", "afternoon"))
collection("sam.marbles", "marble", "sam", source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
collection("steve.marbles", "marble", "steve", source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
collection("sally.marbles", "marble", "sally", source("Sally has 5 less than Sam"))
multiple(at("sam.marbles.count", "initial"), at("steve.marbles.count", "initial"), 2, source("Sam has twice as many marbles as Steve"))
offset(at("sally.marbles.count", "initial"), at("sam.marbles.count", "initial"), -5, "count", source("Sally has 5 less than Sam"))
transfer("sam_to_sally", "sam", at("sam.marbles.count", "current"), at("sally.marbles.count", "current"), 3, source("Sam has given Sally and Steve 3 marbles each"))
transfer("sam_to_steve", "sam", at("sam.marbles.count", "current"), at("steve.marbles.count", "current"), 3, source("Sam has given Sally and Steve 3 marbles each"))
observe(at("sam.marbles.count", "now"), 8, "count", source("Sam has 8 marbles left"))
query("value", at("steve.marbles.count", "now"))
